title: Changeover relay blueprint
description: One relay, as code: the case fields, the handoff, the playbook the agent follows and the connectors it may call. A file is exactly one blueprint of schema `changeover.blueprint/2.0`, written as YAML 1.2 or JSON, and is validated by this schema, then by the relay linter. Secret values never appear in a blueprint: use a `{ "$secret": "sec_…" }` reference.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint. It is ignored by validation; in YAML use the header comment `# yaml-language-server: $schema=<url>` instead.

slug.description: URL-safe id, unique inside the organization: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

title.description: The relay's display name, shown in the Studio, the gallery and the run header.

tagline.description: One sentence for cards and the gallery.

industry.description: The industry this relay belongs to; it drives sample wording and gallery filters.

locale.description: The only supported locale so far: `en-US`.

id.description: snake_case intent id. The extractor's format is named `<id>_patch` and the case JSON carries it.

intent.description: The single intent the relay finishes: its id, a summary line and the noun for the case it builds.

roles.description: What the three parties are called in prompts and labels: the rep, the customer and the organization.

origin.description: Where the blueprint came from: `seed` (shipped), `user`, `draft` or `clone`.

sampleOnly.description: Always true: disclosures and business rules in a blueprint are samples, never legal advice.

meta.description: Identity and framing: what this relay is, who the parties are and where it came from.

facts.description: The named facts a case may reference as `{fact.<key>}`.
